reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses segregation mechanisms and d-band theory in a different HEA system (PdCuPtNiCo) and for OH adsorption, not ethanol oxidation. It does not provide specific prior evidence that annealing PtPdRhRuIrOs nanoparticles induces Pt/Pd surface segregation, nor that such segregation tunes the d-band center to improve ethanol oxidation performance. The key premises thus lack direct support from the cited passages.
premises: Annealing induces surface segregation in PtPdRhRuIrOs HEA nanoparticles
Surface segregation enriches Pt or Pd at the catalyst surface
Pt/Pd enrichment shifts the d-band center and modifies adsorbate binding energies
Modified binding energies enhance ethanol oxidation activity, selectivity, and durability
